verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a self-serve audience export (CSV or other open format) covering contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, or suppression lists. The closest items are API, MCP, and CLI access to read and write contacts, with JSON output for scripting, plus viewing contacts on the Audience page. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an export capability, and nothing covers engagement history or suppression-list export.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
